headline: Frontline Bases Shift Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the central corridor has erupted. Stlican Shelf recorded six ownership changes in the past two hours and ten in six, pushing its daily total to thirty‑four; Fishermans Row added six flips in two hours and twenty in the day; Weathered Expanse, quiet in the previous window, now shows three flips in two hours and twenty‑six overall. Deadlands, previously the most volatile sector, has gone silent in the latest two‑hour period (zero flips) and its six‑hour count fell to four, though the day still logs fifteen. Callahans Passage and Marban Hollow each posted their first recent turnovers, with two and three flips respectively in the last two hours. Godcrofts and Kings Cage have cooled, each registering no new flips in two hours and only modest six‑hour activity. Casualty streams surged sharply in the most recent hour on all active fronts, yet the two‑hour comparison shows cooling rates in Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Deadlands, Godcrofts and Kings Cage, while Callahans Passage and Marban Hollow display accelerating losses. Enlistment rates rose sharply at Callahans Passage and Kings Cage, modestly at Marban Hollow, but fell across Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Deadlands, Godcrofts, Farranac Coast and Linn Mercy. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held south remain static with no base turnovers.
